items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Kid Rennie was pretty hot. ... Rennie was playing with the city.

ctx.x: Well, now, uh... Hey, you want a clean piece of paper? No, that's all right. No, that's as good as I can't get to throw this over. Now, ragtime, who were the outstanding bands, you know, for the head music, the other music?
Well, I'll tell you the truth. Kid Rennie was pretty hot.
When you were a little boy?
